item.title: Parking on the common and paddling pool, 29th July
item.description:
Cars, vans, icecream van parked on the grass area of the common. One car near the entrance to the playground. Some cars parked 3 deep. This is not ok. It’s a conservation area. It’s dangerous. Signs need to be erected to disallow parking or driving on the grass. There are tyre marks from doughnut manoeuvres. As a resident on lakedale it’s impossible to park as it is. But this summer it’s wild. With hornfair splash park closed I suspect this site is going to be insanely busy all summer. A long term solution needs to be put in to place. Or just close the paddling pool. It’s a safety risk at this point and not fun or safe for the people who live here. Or those that use the pool. Serious overcrowding there today. Kids riding bikes around the pool. I have young children. But refuse to use this resource whilst the area is being abused with parking, rubbish, Antisocial behaviour. It’s a great resource to have in theory but some management needs to be put in place. Primarily the car use and parking.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Lakedale Road, Plumstead
Report on FixMyStreet
